answer: Latency-sharded credential auction. Each identity must win a time-delayed credential slot before bidding; wins are hashed into an umber commit chain binding future actions to prior slot purchases. Reaching the sybil nadir requires buying slots across many shards, and slot prices rise on a per-shard onyx curve tied to distinct machine fingerprints, so the marginal clone pays more than any expected gain. Attacker cost: one slot purchase per clone plus fingerprint-diversity overhead, strictly exceeding clone revenue.
